sanskrit:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव
दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम्।
अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा
योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम्।।
image_english: A person who accepts devotional service surpasses the results of all Vedic rituals and attains the supreme goal.
caption:
Chapter 8, Verse 28

Kṛṣṇa concludes Chapter 8. ‘vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva’ (A person who accepts the path of devotional service is not bereft of the results derived from studying the Vedas, performing austere sacrifices, giving charity, or pursuing philosophical and fruitive activities). ‘dāneṣu yat puṇya-phalaṁ pradiṣṭam’. ‘atyeti tat sarvam idaṁ viditvā’ (Simply by performing devotional service, he attains all these, and at the end he reaches the supreme eternal abode). Bhakti is the shortcut that includes the long road. You get the PhD (Bhakti) and automatically get the credit for the High School Diploma (Vedas/Tapas).
